title: 2483. Minimum Penalty for a Shop

examples.explanation: - Closing the shop at the 0th hour incurs in 1+1+0+1 = 3 penalty. - Closing the shop at the 1st hour incurs in 0+1+0+1 = 2 penalty. - Closing the shop at the 2nd hour incurs in 0+0+0+1 = 1 penalty. - Closing the shop at the 3rd hour incurs in 0+0+1+1 = 2 penalty. - Closing the shop at the 4th hour incurs in 0+0+1+0 = 1 penalty. Closing the shop at 2nd or 4th hour gives a minimum penalty. Since 2 is earlier, the optimal closing time is 2.
It is best to close the shop at the 0th hour as no customers arrive.
It is best to close the shop at the 4th hour as customers arrive at each hour.
